race.description: Breast Cancer Awareness Month Mdn Plate
race.comment: STARZAIN (11) adds interest as an unraced filly who won a comfortable Toowoomba Inner Track trial and has a useful family, so she has the right profile to be competitive on debut. MR HILTON (1) drops back from Saturday company after pulling up with an excuse at Eagle Farm. Drawn well and can play a role in the finish. SPOILT ROTTEN (2) chased gamely into a midfield finish when resuming at Beaudesert last time when resuming. With added fitness and the benefit of a cosy alley he can give this a shake. Similar story for OUR COMBINATION (7) who should improve with a run under her belt. Suspect she will drift back from the gate though and be doing her best work late.
